name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
candidate:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h₁ : a.Subset c) (h₂ : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_append] at hx ⊢
    exact hx.elim (fun ha => Or.inl (h₁ ha)) (fun hb => Or.inr (h₂ hb))
  induction h with
  | const | op | bvar | fvar =>
    simp [extractOldExprVars, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
  | abs _ ih => exact ih
  | quant _ _ ihtr ihe => exact app ihtr ihe
  | app _ _ hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x hx
      exact hx
    . next hne =>
      exfalso
      specialize hn ?_
      constructor
      cases hn
      apply hne
      rfl
    . exact app ihfn ihe
  | ite _ _ _ ihc iht ihe => exact app (app ihc iht) ihe
  | eq _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact app ih1 ih2
